# Manuel Warum

> IT professional working in AI-assisted software engineering (AIDLC) — the
> whole development life cycle with AI assistance, from first prompt to
> shipped code and beyond. Open to AI engineering roles.

The site is a one-page profile disguised as a Magic: The Gathering card deck:
each card is one facet — his engineering work, his hobbies, his open-data
contributions, and how to reach him. Card-flavoured wording
("Legendary Creature — Artificer Wizard") is presentation, not job history.

## Pages

- [Profile, markdown edition](https://mrmanny.github.io/index.md): The complete site as clean prose — career focus, hobbies, OpenStreetMap work, and contact links. Start here.

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/MrManny): Source code and open-source contributions.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/manuel-w-a54850235): Professional profile; the fastest way to reach him about roles.
- [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/user/MrManny): Open-data mapping contributions since 2015.

## Optional

- [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Manuel-Warum): Research publications.
